knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says a clear quote states the measured area, the named finish, the condition check and the exclusions. A per-square-metre price on its own, with nothing stated, or a promise that the floor will look new, is not a clear quote.

The lesson says the two vendor figures do not reconcile, so the choice changes the answer. It says to state the source of the figure used and replace it with your own average invoice, so pricing from your own timed work is the defensible choice.

The lesson says to record the floor's condition, previous finishes and any defects before the job starts, because a condition surcharge is only shown after inspection. The client's postcode and the vendor's price list do not describe the floor.
